// embedding reader, generated by kohakutt.dsl.metal.
// Change the program's model, not this file.
#include <stdint.h>

#include "api/dataflow/dataflow_api.h"

// Common arguments: index address, table address, out address, units, dt, blocks, n, vt, core count.
// Per-core arguments: core index.
void kernel_main() {
    constexpr auto index_args = TensorAccessorArgs<0>();
    constexpr auto table_args = TensorAccessorArgs<index_args.next_compile_time_args_offset()>();
    constexpr auto out_args = TensorAccessorArgs<table_args.next_compile_time_args_offset()>();
    constexpr uint32_t cb_index = 0, cb_out = 1, cb_stage = 2;
    const uint32_t index_addr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t table_addr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(1);
    const uint32_t out_addr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(2);
    const uint32_t units = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(3);
    const uint32_t dt = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(4);
    const uint32_t blocks = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(5);
    const uint32_t n = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(6);
    const uint32_t vt = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(7);
    const uint32_t cores = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(8);
    const uint32_t core = get_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const auto index = TensorAccessor(index_args, index_addr, 4096);
    const auto table = TensorAccessor(table_args, table_addr, 2048);
    const auto out = TensorAccessor(out_args, out_addr, 2048);
    cb_reserve_back(cb_index, 1);
    const uint32_t index_ptr = get_write_ptr(cb_index);
    cb_reserve_back(cb_out, 1);
    const uint32_t out_ptr = get_write_ptr(cb_out);
    cb_reserve_back(cb_stage, 1);
    const uint32_t stage_ptr = get_write_ptr(cb_stage);
    uint32_t loaded = 4294967295;
    for (uint32_t u = core; u < units; u += cores) {
        const uint32_t col = u % dt;
        const uint32_t block = (u / dt) % blocks;
        const uint32_t b = (u / dt) / blocks;
        if (block != loaded) {
            noc_async_read_page(block, index, index_ptr);
            noc_async_read_barrier();
            loaded = block;
        }
        const uint32_t rows = (n - (block * 32)) < 32 ? n - (block * 32) : 32;
        for (uint32_t row = 0; row < rows; ++row) {
            const uint32_t id = reinterpret_cast<volatile uint32_t*>(index_ptr)[((row >> 4) * 256) + (row & 15)];
            const uint32_t page = (((b * vt) + (id / 32)) * dt) + col;
            const uint32_t r = id % 32;
            for (uint32_t half = 0; half < 2; ++half) {
                const uint32_t src = (((((r >> 4) * 2) + half) * 256) + ((r & 15) * 16)) * 2;
                noc_async_read(table.get_noc_addr(page, src), stage_ptr + (((row * 2) + half) * 64) + (src & 63), 32);
            }
        }
        noc_async_read_barrier();
        {
            const uint32_t ids = index_ptr;
            const uint32_t stage = stage_ptr;
            const uint32_t out_tile = out_ptr;
            const auto* id_words = reinterpret_cast<volatile uint32_t*>(ids);
            for (uint32_t row = 0; row < rows; ++row) {
                const uint32_t r = id_words[(row >> 4) * 256 + (row & 15)] % 32;
                for (uint32_t half = 0; half < 2; ++half) {
                    const uint32_t src = (((r >> 4) * 2 + half) * 256 + (r & 15) * 16) * 2;
                    const uint32_t dst = (((row >> 4) * 2 + half) * 256 + (row & 15) * 16) * 2;
                    const auto* from = reinterpret_cast<volatile uint32_t*>(
                        stage + (row * 2 + half) * 64 + (src & 63));
                    auto* to = reinterpret_cast<volatile uint32_t*>(out_tile + dst);
                    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
                        to[i] = from[i];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        noc_async_write_page((((b * blocks) + block) * dt) + col, out, out_ptr);
        noc_async_write_barrier();
    }
}
